## `src/dates.ts`

- `parseDay(day)` (line 7): validates the string against `YYYY-MM-DD` and returns a `Date`.
- `formatDay(date)` (line 19): formats a `Date` back to `YYYY-MM-DD`.

   - `formatDay(parseDay("2026-11-15"))` → `"2026-11-14"`

export interface RateLimiterOptions {
  capacity: number;
  refillPerSecond: number;
  now?: () => number;
}

export interface TakeResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  retryAfterMs: number;
}

interface Bucket {
  tokens: number;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export function createRateLimiter(options: RateLimiterOptions): { take(key: string, cost?: number): TakeResult } {
  const { capacity, refillPerSecond } = options;
  const now = options.now ?? Date.now;
  const buckets = new Map<string, Bucket>();

  function refill(bucket: Bucket, at: number): void {
    const elapsedMs = at - bucket.updatedAt;
    if (elapsedMs > 0 && refillPerSecond > 0) {
      bucket.tokens = Math.min(capacity, bucket.tokens + (elapsedMs / 1000) * refillPerSecond);
    }
    bucket.updatedAt = Math.max(bucket.updatedAt, at);
  }

  return {
    take(key, cost = 1) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(cost) || cost < 1 || cost > capacity) {
        throw new RangeError(...);
      }
      const at = now();
      let bucket = buckets.get(key);
      if (!bucket) { bucket = { tokens: capacity, updatedAt: at }; buckets.set(key, bucket); }
      refill(bucket, at);
      if (bucket.tokens + 1e-9 >= cost) { // epsilon? 
        bucket.tokens = Math.max(0, bucket.tokens - cost);
        return { allowed: true, remaining: Math.floor(bucket.tokens), retryAfterMs: 0 };
      }
      const missing = cost - bucket.tokens;
      const retryAfterMs = refillPerSecond > 0 ? Math.ceil((missing / refillPerSecond) * 1000) : Infinity;
      return { allowed: false, remaining: Math.floor(bucket.tokens), retryAfterMs };
    },
  };
}
